text:
maria (Marketing): Ok team — planning refapp launch for "Studio Spark" tutorial + benchmark blog + short webinar. Goal: community signups + dev adoption. Timeline: draft post by Fri, webinar week after. Need: benchmark narrative, demo script, hero gif, inbound lead routing. Who can own which?

aj (DevRel): I can take demo script + 15m hands-on section. Can we do a 30-min webinar: 15 demo, 10 Q&A, 5 next steps? @maria what's the target audience (beginners vs infra folks)?

liam (Product Marketing): Target: devs building inference products — focus on cost/latency comparison vs raw self-host. Benchmark narrative should highlight batching + caching wins, consistent latency across modes. I'll draft benchmark talking points. Need reproducible numbers — @kyle can you pull per-token cost delta from recent perf run?

kyle (Analytics): Got it. I'll pull numbers from the Feb perf run tonight. Expect top-line table: tokens/sec, p95 latency, $/1M tokens for hosted vs dedicated vs private (baseline). Also give error bars. ETA EOD tomorrow.

sophia (Growth): I'll lead webinar landing page copy + registration funnel. For routing: send registrants to HubSpot list 'Studio Spark Launch' and tag 'oss-refapp' and 'webinar'. After event, route attendees to 'product-trials' flow. Anyone prefer a 1-click meeting invite from Sales? :thinking_face:

maria (Marketing): Yes 1-click meeting from Sales is good for warm leads. @salesbot can you confirm Sales availability week after webinar?

salesbot: Sales availability check: @jordan (AE) and @nina (AE) available Tue-Fri next week. I'll add calendar block placeholder. :calendar:

aj (DevRel): For demo assets — I'll need a sandbox refapp repo link, and a Docker image tag. @devrel-bot can we cut a refapp preview branch and a small dataset for the demo?

devrel-bot: preview branch 'studio-spark/demo-preview' created at https://github.com/redwood-inference/studio-spark/compare/demo-preview. Docker image pushed: ghcr.io/redwood/studio-spark:preview-20260415

liam (Product Marketing): For benchmark narrative, propose these 3 callouts: 1) 2.3x throughput w/ batching+KV cache, 2) 40% cost savings with quantization + autoscaling, 3) predictable p95 with dedicated pools. Will write short section and share numbers.

kyle (Analytics): FYI the perf run shows 2.1x throughput on average (depending on prompt length), 38% median cost reduction with q4/auto-batch. I'll include per-model breakdown.

sophia (Growth): Landing page CTA options: 'Try the refapp' (repo + hosted demo), 'Join webinar', 'Get a cost estimate'. I prefer 'Join webinar' primary. Also can we add 'benchmark quick glance' image? @design?

andrew (Design): I'll mock up hero GIF + benchmark carousel. Can I get the raw numbers and example prompts? ETA Tue morning.

maria (Marketing): Perfect. Also routing for inbound leads from blog post: webhook -> HubSpot list, add lead tag 'oss-refapp', send high-intent (signup + trial) to Sales slack channel #sales-inbound with CSV of metadata. Sample payload below:

```json
{
  "email": "registrant.email",
  "name": "registrant.name",
  "company": "registrant.company",
  "role": "registrant.role",
  "actions": ["webinar_reg", "repo_clone", "hosted_demo"],
  "interest_score": "computed_score",
  "model_choice": "gpt-like-xxl",
  "tokens_used_est": "1200",
  "p95_latency_ms": "320"
}
```

kyle (Analytics): Will enrich payload with model_choice, tokens_used_est, p95_latency_ms, demo_action (play/run).

jordan (AE): If possible add company_size and contact_role fields. Sales can triage. Also include 'interest_score' computed from actions.

sophia (Growth): Let's set a simple interest scoring: webinar_reg=1, hosted_demo=2, repo_star=1, trial_request=5, attendance=3. We'll include in payload.

maria (Marketing): Great — next steps: liam draft benchmark + numbers by Tue EOD, aj demo script Wed, design hero Tue morning, kyle perf tables Tue EOD, sophia landing + routing config Wed, devrel create PR and final assets Thu. Check-in sync Thurs 10am. :rocket:
